adjudication.rationale: The diff does show inconsistent “fetch credential from DB” fallback shapes: in `packages/core/EventManager.ts` the fallback `prisma.credential.findUnique({ include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}}})` is mapped into a `CredentialWithAppName`-like object with an explicit `appName: credentialFromDB.app.slug` (and other fields), while in `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts` the fallback `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId }})` is assigned directly to `calendarCredential` (no `appName`, and no `include app`). That inconsistency is verifiable from the diff and is a concrete review concern because the codebase now has two different “credential shapes” coming from DB fallbacks. However, the claimed downstream breakage (whether `getCalendar` routes on `appName`, whether app slugs are hyphenated vs underscore, and whether this causes silent no-ops / wrong routing) cannot be confirmed from this diff alone since `getCalendar`’s resolution logic and the actual slug conventions aren’t shown here.
